name: Visitors of Île aux Aigrettes, Mauritius
description: Flower visitors on a small coral islet off Mauritius, counted over the 1999 flowering season. The introduced honey bee visits most of the plants, and the endemic day gecko Phelsuma ornata pollinates alongside the insects.

citation.text: Jens M. Olesen and Louise I. Eskildsen and Shadila Venkatasamy (2002). Invasion of pollination networks on oceanic islands: importance of invader complexes and endemic super generalists.
